title: Biblical Overlap Mining — Wave 21 Next Leads: Stewardship, Hidden Authority and End/Beginning
status: research leads; not yet public comparator promotions
rule: These are source-backed project formulations with plausible high-value biblical structures, but they remain leads until each gets a full scene/context/countertext dossier.

leads.possible_structure: Garden is tended/kept rather than merely possessed; legitimate greatness serves rather than lords over; shepherd authority is judged by care of the flock.
leads.reason: This could become the clearest biblical ethical definition of the Gardener turn: authority proves itself by improving conditions for life rather than maximizing domination.
leads.boundary: Genesis 2 stewardship, Gospel servant leadership and Ezekiel's shepherd critique are distinct textual contexts and should not be collapsed.

leads.project_wording: the end is in the beginning too
leads.possible_structure: end is declared from beginning; first/last and beginning/end are held in one divine frame
leads.reason: This may be a stronger biblical neighbor for Spiral/seed recurrence than generic Alpha/Omega symbolism because Isaiah explicitly places end and beginning in one sentence.
leads.boundary: The project formulation suggests recurrence/potential within beginnings; Isaiah concerns divine foreknowledge/purpose, not cyclical time.

leads.possible_structure: good action need not be performed for public recognition; greatness serves; quiet faithful life can carry moral weight without prestige display
leads.reason: This can counterbalance the project's extremely public God/King rhetoric by asking whether the strongest authority is sometimes least theatrical.
leads.boundary: The biblical passages concern piety, service and quiet life rather than a single doctrine called 'authority without spectacle'.
